description: Claimed golf booking workflow complete without verifying 8-day booking window requirement. Workflow ran June 27, 2026 (7 days before July 4) but specification requires execution exactly 8 days before target date. Booking succeeded but workflow validation logic failed to catch timing discrepancy.
correction: Must verify booking window (exactly 8 days before target) before claiming success. Abort if today is not 8 days before target_date_primary. Check: (target_date - today) == 8 days.
systemic_fix: Add pre-execution guard to golf-booking SKILL.md: before Step 1, calculate days_until_target = (target_date_primary - today).days. If != 8, abort with log: 'Workflow scheduled for wrong timeframe. Target: [target]. Days until target: [N]. Expected: 8 days. Aborting.' Set status: outside-booking-window.
